Issue material to the job shop

Task 5 of 6 in Production order · next: Report the operation complete and confirm warehouse receipt

Walk it

Before you start

  • You need step 1.1 (Confirm the existing foundation); step 1.4 (Confirm the existing foundation).

Steps

Why LN works this way. Material issue turns the estimated quantities into an outbound warehousing order from the raw-material warehouse to the work center, and each issued quantity books a WIP transaction. That first WIP transaction is what moves the order to Active; release alone does not. How much of the outbound procedure LN runs for you depends on two check boxes on the material line.

StepActionYou should see
5.1Open Manufacturing➔Job Shop➔Production Materials➔Material to Issue for Production Orders (ticst0101m100) for the order released in Release the orderThe component line from step 1.1 (Confirm the existing foundation) is listed, with Production Order Status = Released
5.2Read Estimated Quantity and Actual Quantity for the component lineActual Quantity = 0
5.3Read To Issue by WarehouseWrite downmaterial to issue = the To Issue by Warehouse figure
5.4If the line is not already unblocked, run Initiate Inventory Issue (tisfc0207m000) for the lineThe material's warehouse order line unblocks
5.5Open Warehousing Orders (whinh2100m000) and find the production issue order for this production orderThe order shows order type 30- Production (Out), source the component warehouse from step 1.4 (Confirm the existing foundation), destination the work center from the routing
5.6Click Drill In on the issue order — Warehousing Order (whinh2100m100)The order lines and the Outbound Line Status Overview (whinh2129m000) activity list are visible
5.7If Generate Outbound Advice is unfinished and not automatic, run itThe advice is generated
5.8If Release Outbound Advice is unfinished and not automatic, run itThe advice is released
5.9Continue the outbound procedure until the issue order reaches ShippedOrdered and advised quantities match; the order shows Shipped
5.10Return to Material to Issue for Production Orders and Production OrdersActual Quantity = the estimated quantity, To Issue by Warehouse = 0;Write downorder status after material issue = Active

If something goes wrong

SymptomWhat to do
The material line stays blocked / To Issue by Warehouse never appearsRun Initiate Inventory Issue (tisfc0207m000) manually; if still blocked, stop and record what was observed
The issue stops short and a shortage report printsA component's stock is short and negative inventory is not allowed. The quantity waits in To Issue by Warehouse; restock, then process the warehousing order by hand
Generate/Release Outbound Advice are missing or already actionedDo not assume a fault. Direct Process Warehouse Order Line may be automatic for this material — confirm in Activities by Warehousing Order (whinh2104m000) before troubleshooting further

Variations

CaseWhat changes
More than one component

Record and compare every expected component and estimated quantity in Verify the generated foundation; issue every material line in this task; the steps do not change

Fully automatic material issue

If Direct Initiate Inventory Issue and Direct Process Warehouse Order Line are both selected for the material, steps 4–9 complete themselves once the order is released; the steps do not change

Production order
Issue material to the job shop

  1. Open Material to Issue for Production Orders for the order released in Release the order

    Manufacturing➔Job Shop➔Production Materials➔Material to Issue for Production Orders

    You should see

    The component line from step 1 of Confirm the existing foundation is listed, with Production Order Status = Released

  2. Read Estimated Quantity and Actual Quantity for the component line

    You should see

    Actual Quantity = 0

  3. Read To Issue by Warehouse

    Write down

    material to issue = the To Issue by Warehouse figure

  4. If the line is not already unblocked, run Initiate Inventory Issue for the line

    You should see

    The material's warehouse order line unblocks

  5. Open Warehousing Orders and find the production issue order for this production order

    You should see

    The order shows order type 30- Production (Out), source the component warehouse from step 4 of Confirm the existing foundation, destination the work center from the routing

  6. Click Drill In on the issue order

    Warehousing Order

    You should see

    The order lines and the Outbound Line Status Overview (whinh2129m000) activity list are visible

  7. If Generate Outbound Advice is unfinished and not automatic, run it

    You should see

    The advice is generated

  8. If Release Outbound Advice is unfinished and not automatic, run it

    You should see

    The advice is released

  9. Continue the outbound procedure until the issue order reaches Shipped

    You should see

    Ordered and advised quantities match; the order shows Shipped

  10. Return to Material to Issue for Production Orders and Production Orders

    You should see

    Actual Quantity = the estimated quantity, To Issue by Warehouse = 0;

    Write down

    order status after material issue = Active

    • The material line stays blocked / To Issue by Warehouse never appears

      Run Initiate Inventory Issue (tisfc0207m000) manually; if still blocked, stop and record what was observed

    • The issue stops short and a shortage report prints

      A component's stock is short and negative inventory is not allowed. The quantity waits in To Issue by Warehouse; restock, then process the warehousing order by hand

    • Generate/Release Outbound Advice are missing or already actioned

      Do not assume a fault. Direct Process Warehouse Order Line may be automatic for this material — confirm in Activities by Warehousing Order (whinh2104m000) before troubleshooting further

  • Material issue turns the estimated quantities into an outbound warehousing order from the raw-material warehouse to the work center, and each issued quantity books a WIP transaction. That first WIP transaction is what moves the order to Active; release alone does not. How much of the outbound procedure LN runs for you depends on two check boxes on the material line.
